scope: CPU-only implementation contracts using a tiny fake Qwen backbone; no learned quality, real-checkpoint performance, Jev parity or production acceptance claim
resource_scope: Before/after host samples, CPU fake-model workload only; sampled RAM and VRAM reserves exceeded 10%. Other parent work may use the GPU concurrently.
coverage: one direct text-backbone forward with inference mode, no cache, no vocabulary projection or generation
last-token L2-normalized readout, binary softmax, threshold decisions and equality
policy serialization preserves supplied messages as quoted data
whole-message characters, serialized-token limits, no truncation, media rejection
malformed inputs and unresolved multi-turn context fail closed
artifact size, schema, labels, dimensions, checksums, finite parameters and actual checkpoint identity
POLICY_FEATURE policy hash and unquantized BF16 inference profile
gate rejection occurs before routing or executor access
not_abstain still subject to existing verifier rejection
binary receipt retained through early fallback returns
limitations: fake backbone is not semantic model evaluation
no real GPU kernels, deployment, serving concurrency or sustained operational test
no mutations beyond pytest temporary fixtures and the two authorized repository files
